mentions.name: Kan
mentions.description: This Go CLI serves a Kanban board (`kan serve`) as a localhost web page that acts on plaintext JSON & TOML files stored locally in your repo, so board changes can be committed like any other files. Boards can be initialized with `kan init` and manipulated from the terminal via commands like `kan add` and `kan edit`, and all boards can be navigated from a single serve instance. The web board is written in TypeScript, and the repo includes a SKILL markdown file so Claude can read and interact with the boards.
